model: v[n] = K_vx x[n] cos(2 pi f_c n/f_s + phi). Signed differential bridge signal, zero static offset.
mixer: I = round(2 ADC cos_NCO), Q = round(-2 ADC sin_NCO). 16-bit signed reference lookup, normalized by 32767. ADC and mixer use nearest-even rounding.
recovery: x_hat = ADC_LSB (I_out cos(phi) + Q_out sin(phi)) / (K_vx G_DC). No magnitude rectification and no delay correction.
schedule: One accepted I/Q sample per simulation clock. Signal time is input sample index / 1 MHz. Accelerated valid schedule does not test 100 MHz device timing.
